title: Training Note: On-Peak Usage Courtesy in Residential Electricity Supply Disputes
content:
Training note, Residential Electricity Supply billing disputes.

**Q. What is the dispute usage courtesy?**
A. A flat addition to the disputed amount set by the agreement's on-peak consumption. The average kWh of the agreement's on-peak energy lines is taken; at 700 kWh or more the high dispute usage courtesy of 2.00 USD is added, from 400 up to but not including 700 kWh the mid dispute usage courtesy of 1.00 USD is added, and below 400 kWh nothing is added.

**Q. How is the average formed?**
A. The kWh on all of the agreement's on-peak energy lines, whenever billed, divided by the number of those on-peak lines. Off-peak lines are not part of it. An agreement with no on-peak lines adds nothing.

| Average on-peak kWh per on-peak line | Dispute usage courtesy |
|---|---|
| 700 or more | 2.00 USD |
| 400 up to but not including 700 | 1.00 USD |
| below 400 | nothing |

**Q. A hypothetical case?**
A. Five on-peak lines totalling 3,450 kWh average 690 kWh and add 1.00 USD; at 3,500 kWh the average is 700 kWh and adds 2.00 USD.
